title: Bestiario · todos los del juego
description: The bestiary (just bestiario, bestiario.html, src/bestiary.ts): everyone in the game from its own data, with the 3D model the game draws, portraits and concept art, traits, simulated moves, the fight's question and the model's animations. Run uv run python tools/bestiary.py first (just bestiario does) so the concept art shows, and run it with --gpu. Its last shots write notes to output/bestiary/notes-scratch.json (?notas=scratch), never to docs/bestiary-notes.json, and empty it at the end.

steps.caption: A castle pupil: El Repetidor, still drawn with the palace minion (placeholder badge), its new designs in the strip, its PV by year, the moves the bot saw it make and its question
The list filtered to what needs a model of its own (placeholders and beings with none)
An ally: Gerard at 35, his game model, portrait and the just character-3d images

An ánima: Matemágico worn by Gerard at 35, dressed by the game's own wearClass (blueprint blue ruled in gold, the digits), with its colour, what it adds, how it grows, its skills, the jar's tree, passives and duals
Matemágico on Gerard as a boy: the only ánima he has in chapter 1
Papagato on Gerard (35), front-on: Haru's orange and Yuki's white, the ears, tail and bell, and the two cats at his feet (createCat)
The same ánima on Aitor: Papagato is shared, so the switch offers him
Sin ánima: Gerard in his own clothes, to compare
Tecnópata, Aitor's own: graphite and cyan, his glasses a HUD, and Bip floating beside him (createBip)
A pupil just selected: El Repetidor's new model front-on, its walk restarted from the first frame, no spin
The street dogs, built by the fight's own buildStreetDogs, each in its coat and collar
A foe with a procedural model of its own: Vertitrón, its moves and its targets
El Campeón, Càmping Eurosport's mini-boss, redone: the board game's villain as a Meshy figure, the furnace grate in his chest, his Plan and his Rayo
La Lealtad, a Meshy figure with a touch of Marta: her two-tone hair and hoops, the shield strung like a harp, the amber knot in code on top
An Eco, a breaking wave of pale glass floating over the floor, lit from inside, its rings round the bead
Lo Directo, a knight built of sword blades edged in light, its lance of light beside it
El Cebollón, Uri's fear made realistic: a man-sized onion with torn dry skins and roots like legs
El Plato Misterioso: a tarnished cloche lifted on something pale and wet, on a café table
A fantasmita: an arcade ghost of magenta glass cubes coming apart at its edges
A monster being designed: El Castigado, its design image, its views and its pipeline steps
A person: Nuria, her model, portrait and expressions
